turns.content: I want to travel from Islamabad to Dubai for 5 days. My budget is $1500. I prefer a comfortable hotel.
Before I search, I need your departure date.

Here is a 5-day plan for Islamabad to Dubai from 24 Dec 2026 to 28 Dec 2026. Recommended flight: Airblue PA 210, departs 24 Dec 06:10, returns on PA 211 at 28 Dec 16:20, 381.60 USD per person. Recommended hotel: Al Barsha Garden Suites (Al Barsha, rated 4.4), 142.00 USD per night. Estimated cost: 1,056.60 USD. Why: Airblue PA 210 departs 06:10 and arrives 08:30, direct, 381.60 USD per person. Al Barsha Garden Suites (Al Barsha) is rated 4.4 at 142.00 USD per night and meets your 4+ rating preference. Flights, hotel and an activity allowance of 250.00 USD come to about 1,199.60 USD against a budget of 1,500.00 USD. Expected weather: Warm and sunny, around 26°C (climate average).
